key_insight: Topology-guided regional latent dynamics enable full-field transient structural response prediction while preserving spatial organization and learning history-dependent behavior.
engineering_relevance: TPLD targets surrogate prediction for large nonlinear finite element models, including impact and vehicle crash simulations with heterogeneous components.
method: Encode mesh responses into coupled regional latent variables using topology and engineering priors.
Improve latent dynamics with auxiliary one-step prediction and predict trajectories using load-conditioned spatiotemporal Mamba.
Reconstruct nodal response fields with a shared coordinate-conditioned decoder.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on three FE datasets, TPLD reports displacement-component relative L2 errors of 1.41–12.22% on an approximately 1.49-million-node vehicle model and 0.620% position error on the BIW benchmark, 30.7% below the best GeoTransolver configuration.
watch_item: Generalization to unseen geometries, load regimes, and regional partitions is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Topology-Prior-Guided Regional Latent Dynamics for Transient Structural Response Prediction
